messages:
Diego: kicked off a quick-merge of cust-boreas LoRA onto baseline-xlarge int4 this AM. ran the 'currency-jitter' evalpack and seeing weird spacing/commas in amounts. filing thread to triage.
Priya: link?
Diego: internal eval: https://redwood.internal/evals/ZZ999 (private)
Diego: repro snippet:
```bash
./tools/quick_eval --model=boreas-lora-merged-int4 --eval=currency-jitter --limit=500 --seed=7 --out=out.json
```
Nora: paste one failing pair please (orig vs merged output)
Diego: example: 
```text
PROMPT: "Amount owed: $" + amt + "\nPlease remit."
BASELINE (float32): "Amount owed: $2,110.00
Please remit."
MERGED-INT4: "Amount owed: $2,110 .00
Please remit."
```
QA: spacing before decimal, sometimes comma disappears on thousands e.g., "2110" vs "2,110". overall EM drop ~25% on money-format tests.
Priya: sounds like tokenization boundary differences combined with quant-induced tokenization fragmentation. which tokenizer was used for the customer's LoRA?
Diego: they trained with a patched BPE that treats "," as part of numeric tokens. our merge used model-r1 standard BPE.
Nora: two quick checks: 1) re-run eval with their tokenizer mapping (we have the pack in cust-artifacts), 2) test merged-int4 but with token-merge-fix flag (mask-split-punct) enabled to see if runtime masking recovers formatting.
Priya: also try shadowing int8 path: run exact same eval against merged-int8 to isolate quant step. if int8 matches baseline but int4 diverges, problem is quantization sensitivity.
Diego: queued jobs: "eval-with-cust-tokenizer" and "merged-int8-smoke". Infra-bot: jobs scheduled on `ml-test-queue`, ETA ~30m.
Nora: if tokenizer mismatch is root cause, options: a) reapply LoRA weights after token-remap to align, b) ship tokenizer compatibility layer at decode time (fast but messy), c) recommend retrain LoRA with standard tokenizer for long-term.
Priya: for customer-facing rollback, propose adding a feature-flagged canary that routes their traffic to float32 or int8 until we patch. Diego, can you draft a short note for PM + CS?
Diego: will draft now and ping CS. adding evaluation artifacts to the repo.
QA: small note: some samples also show decimal digits split into two tokens causing stray space when detokenized. add `--detok-preserve-numeric` to debug output.
Diego: good call. I'll re-run with detok flag and post diffs.
Priya: thanks all. let's reconvene in ~45m with results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
